manual.title: Manual Setup
manual.description:
Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your SVS subwoofer. Format: {mac_format}

Tip: Use `bluetoothctl` and `scan on` to find your subwoofer's MAC address.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm SVS Subwoofer
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name} ({address})?

user.title: SVS Subwoofer
user.description: Add another subwoofer, or combine subwoofers you have already added into a group.

add_subwoofer.title: Add SVS Subwoofer
add_subwoofer.description:
Select your subwoofer from the list below. Devices are shown by the name you set in the SVS app (e.g., RIGHTSUB, LEFTSUB). Devices marked [SVS] are detected SVS subwoofers.

Leave the name blank to use the device's advertised name.

create_group.title: Create a Subwoofer Group
create_group.description: A group controls several subwoofers together from one device. Changing a subwoofer on its own never changes the group or the other subwoofers.

data_description.features: Each enabled setting gets a group entity that controls it on every member. Members keep all of their own controls.

group_volume.title: Group Volume
group_volume.description: Choose how the group volume moves the subwoofers.

group_offsets.title: Volume Offsets
group_offsets.description: Each subwoofer plays at the group volume plus its offset.

error.duplicate_group: These subwoofers are already a group. Choose different subwoofers, or change the existing group.

init.title: Connection Options
init.description: By default the integration disconnects after 60 seconds without commands so the SVS app can connect. Enable "Stay connected" if commands stop working after the subwoofer has been idle; the integration will then keep the connection open and check it every 30 seconds. Use the Disconnect button when you need the SVS app.

group_members.title: Subwoofer Group
group_members.description: Change the subwoofers in this group and what it controls. To rename the group, use the rename option on its device or integration entry.

data_description.features: Each enabled setting gets a group entity that controls it on every member. Members keep all of their own controls.

group_volume.title: Group Volume
group_volume.description: Choose how the group volume moves the subwoofers.

group_offsets.title: Volume Offsets
group_offsets.description: Each subwoofer plays at the group volume plus its offset.

error.duplicate_group: These subwoofers are already a group. Choose different subwoofers, or change the existing group.

options.matched: Matched – Every subwoofer plays at the group volume.
options.offset: Offset – Each subwoofer plays at the group volume plus its own offset.

group_too_few_members.title: {group} has fewer than two subwoofers
group_too_few_members.description: A subwoofer in the group {group} was removed, so the group now has {count}. A group needs at least two subwoofers. Open the group's settings (Configure) to choose its subwoofers, or delete the group.
